definitions.explanation: A counter for pairs of shoes, socks, and other footwear.

examples.english: To buy one pair of shoes.
examples.notes: いっそく with small っ

examples.japanese: ⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二|に}{足|そく}⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought two pairs of shoes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{靴下|くつした}→靴下：00726_kutsushita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何|なん}{足|ぞく}⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many pairs of socks do you have?
examples.notes: なんぞく with voiced ぞ

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三|さん}{足|ぞく}⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧。⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{白|しろ}→白：noentry⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{茶色|ちゃいろ}→茶色：02915_chairo⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I bought three pairs of new shoes. Black, white, and brown.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{靴下|くつした}→靴下：00726_kutsushita⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{五|ご}{足|そく}⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦いきます→行く：00119_iku⟧。⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{替|か}える→代える：11717_kaeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I'll bring five pairs of socks on the trip. So I can change them every day.

notes:
{足|そく} is the counter for pairs of footwear including shoes, socks, boots, and slippers.

COUNTING PATTERN:
- {一|いっ}{足|そく}: one pair (small っ before そ)
- {二|に}{足|そく}: two pairs
- {三|さん}{足|ぞく}: three pairs (voiced: ぞく)
- {何|なん}{足|ぞく}: how many pairs? (voiced: ぞく)

WHAT IT COUNTS:
- ⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧: shoes
- ⟦{靴下|くつした}→靴下：00726_kutsushita⟧: socks
- ⟦スリッパ→スリッパ：noentry⟧: slippers
- ⟦ブーツ→ブーツ：noentry⟧: boots

NOTE: This counter emphasizes that footwear comes in pairs. For single items, use ⟦{片方|かたほう}→片方：03044_katahou⟧ (one of a pair).
